description: Aligns a new render onto every chara_X portrait frame automatically, then cuts portraits with a movable, paintable mask, like SmashAlign.
align.description: Align a render onto chara_X frames
mask.description: Cut a portrait with a movable mask
align.empty: Choose or import your new render, then the folder holding the original chara_X images to match.
align.hint: Each frame keeps its size; the render is scaled, rotated and moved to match it, and saved in aligned/ as PNG.
notImage: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPG or WEBP image
stage.label: Mask editor. Arrow keys move the mask, Ctrl+Z undoes.
mask.empty: Choose or import an image. Aligned chara_4 images are picked first.
